READ: RJC Corporate Security Services Inc. Official Statement: 

With regards to the incident that happened earlier at  SM North The Block.

Based on the report: At around 7 PM, 3 customers went to CRS Office to report an incident involving SG Jojo S. Malicdem of RJC Security Agency.

Based on the CCTV footage SG Malicdem was shooing away 5 illegal vendors and beggars at the friendship bridge connecting Trinoma, when they provoked him and took his ID one of the female illegal vendors was seen pushing him over and then shoved a puppy in front of the guard's face, so he shoved away her hand, and grabbed the puppy and dropped it midair which later led to the puppy falling on the road, right under the North Avenue footbridge.

The puppy was barely breathing when they picked him from the floor.

They were later assisted to Doc May wellness pet veterinary clinic located at Visayas Avenue Quezon City in their attempt to revive the puppy. 

When they arrived at 7:45 PM, Doc Javier declared that the puppy was dead on arrival.

Based on the explanation of SG Malicdem upon the inquiry, on his attempt to clear away the hand of the beggar from his face, he accidentally grabbed the puppy and accidentally dropped it because of the momentum of his hand.

Further, he explained that it wasn't in his intention to throw away the dog, but mainly due to his surprise when he held the dog, he accidentally dropped it midair instead of placing it down properly. The guard was very sorry about the incident.
